description.value: Pita Pit is a Canadian fast-casual chain serving customizable pita sandwiches, salads, and rice bowls built from fresh ingredients. Located in Fort St. John in northeastern BC, it sits along a key supply corridor for cyclists riding the Alaska Highway region. The menu spans meat, falafel, and build-your-own options with smoothies and desserts also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is the corporate Pita Pit Canada site (pitapit.ca), which confirms the brand is active and offers takeout/pickup. It does not provide location-specific amenity details for the Fort St. John location (no bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi confirmation). OSM tags confirm takeaway=yes, toilets=yes, and air_conditioning=yes, but per rules, OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website corroboration. The menu page and front page confirm vegetarian options (Spicy Falafel listed as a signature item).
concerns: Website is the corporate chain homepage (pitapit.ca) with no Fort St. John location-specific page in fetched content; location-level amenities (washrooms, bike parking, Wi-Fi) cannot be confirmed from available evidence.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food chain with confirmed presence in Fort St. John. Publicly accessible and useful to touring cyclists as a food and takeout stop on the northeastern BC corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Signature menu includes Spicy Falafel (vegetarian); build-your-own options allow further customization. No explicit vegan or GF labelling

wow_evidence: Canadian fast-casual chain serving customizable pita sandwiches
